verdict.rationale: Alacritty documents an IPC channel via `alacritty msg`. The only evidenced command is `create-window`, which mirrors the `CreateNewWindow` keybinding. The many UI interactions (vi mode, search, selection, hints, URL opening) are documented only as keyboard or mouse actions, with no evidence they are reachable programmatically. The runtime probe failed at install time, so it neither confirms nor contradicts IPC behavior. Missing for 10: documented IPC coverage of search, selection, vi mode, hints and config actions; a full IPC command reference; hands-on verification that `alacritty msg` works.
